seo_title: AI for Law Firms: Your Virtual Junior Lawyer
seo_desc: Wasting 40% of your time on basic tasks? We create an AI Junior Lawyer trained on your legal rulings to automate and monetize your law firm.
author_pitch: I have audited law firms where senior partners waste hours drafting NDAs and answering routine questions. As an AI Specialist, I build digital clones of your firm: virtual lawyers that analyze massive case files and bill subscriptions while you sleep.
title: The Junior Lawyer that never sleeps: Automate and scale your law firm
body:
Do you lose 40% of your billable hours answering basic legal questions or drafting standard documents?

Law firms face a critical bottleneck: highly qualified talent wastes almost half of their workday on mechanical tasks. Answering clients about procedural deadlines ("how many days do I have to appeal?"), drafting repetitive payment claims, or reading thousands of pages of a case file to find a key date is not profitable. This manual work suffocates your profit margins, exhausts your team, and prevents you from acquiring a higher volume of high-value strategic cases.

The trap of Generic Chatbots

Many law firms try to innovate using open and generic artificial intelligence tools, risking the confidentiality of their clients' data and obtaining inaccurate answers that fall outside the applicable legal framework. Automated legal advice without the legal rigor of your firm is a malpractice lawsuit waiting to happen.

Our solution: Private and Customized Legal AI

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we develop an encapsulated and private Artificial Intelligence engine. It is not a generic chat; we train this "Junior Lawyer" exclusively with your entire historical database of rulings, contracts, jurisprudence, and, most importantly, your firm's unique writing style.

  1. Immediate Document Automation: Generate lease agreements, NDAs, or legal claims in less than 30 seconds, delivering perfect documents ready for final review and signature.
  2. Complex Case File Analysis: Upload up to 2,000 pages of judicial documentation at once. The AI instantly summarizes key facts, timelines, and possible contradictions.
  3. Absolute Security and Privacy: We deploy the architecture on private servers, ensuring that attorney-client privilege and sensitive data never feed external models.
  4. New Passive Income Channel: We create a "Legal Light" subscription so you can offer SMEs unlimited access to legal consultations with your AI for a flat fee (e.g., €49/month).

The Real Impact on Law Firm Profitability

  • Billable Hours Recovery: Your legal team is freed from documentary bureaucracy to focus exclusively on litigation strategy and high-value negotiations.
  • Scalable and Automatic Monetization: You turn your knowledge into a SaaS product. With just 100 clients on your "Legal Light" plan, you generate almost €5,000 a month in revenue without adding a single man-hour.
  • Competitive Advantage and Efficiency: You multiply your firm's processing capacity, allowing you to accept more simultaneous cases without the need to hire new junior staff.
